reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static List<Integer> allocateFixed(int t,List<Integer>w){long sl=w.stream().mapToLong(x->x).sum();if(sl>10000000)return null;int s=(int)sl;if(t<0||t>10000000||w.isEmpty()||w.stream().anyMatch(x->x<0||x>10000000)||s==0)return null;var o=new ArrayList<Integer>();for(int x:w)o.add((int)((long)t*x/s));int left=t-o.stream().mapToInt(x->x).sum();var idx=new ArrayList<Integer>();for(int i=0;i<w.size();i++)idx.add(i);idx.sort((i,j)->{int c=Long.compare((long)t*w.get(j)%s,(long)t*w.get(i)%s);return c!=0?c:Integer.compare(i,j);});for(int i=0;i<left;i++)o.set(idx.get(i),o.get(idx.get(i))+1);return o;}}
